race.comment: NYMPHADORA (10) frustrating mare resuming. Unlucky not to have a few more wins on the CV and returns in a winnable race on her home track. Closed well in her only trial and can get the better of these fresh. SPRIGHTLY AFFAIR (8) scored a dominant win first-up when she ploughed through the heavy going over 900m at Newcastle. Looks up to this tougher contest from the good gate.  COSMIC ORDER (9) won here four-back and has struggled since. Got too far back from the wide gate with a battling sixth over 1100m at Wyong. At her top for this and can take a hand in the finish. DIRTY SUMMER (2) resumes. Went out a winner over this track and trip last May in a Super Maiden. Fitted with the two trials and ticks a few boxes with the claim.
